messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need to decide how to prioritize 3 customer-reported bugs (C1 flaky streaming, C2 wrong token billing, C3 logs not attached) vs 5 polish/enhancement asks for the next minor release. Goal: ship in ~2 weeks. Suggest criteria by EOD? (cc @Samir @Maria)
Samir: +1. My quick take: billing (C2) is P0, shipping invoices wrong is high risk. Streaming (C1) is annoying but has a workaround. Most enhs -> P2. :thinking_face:
Maria: Agree billing first. For C1 I want more telemetry before we commit to a fix — can't repro reliably. Can SRE add targeted traces? @TJ
TJ: On it. I'll add KV-cache tracing + an optional replay hook by tomorrow morning so we can capture a repro. Note: we have a dedicated canary slot on Thurs.
Ben: Proposal for a short rubric to guide decisions:

```
- P0: data loss / billing / security
- P1: customer-visible correctness / major regressions
- P2: UX polish / perf improvements / low-risk enhancements
```

Keeps it simple for this minor release.
Anya: Mapping the three bugs: C2 -> P0 (billing), C1 -> P1 (streaming, needs repro), C3 -> P1 (logs not attached to traces). Enhancements are mostly P2. I suggest we pick the 2 highest-impact enhs to include, and backlog the rest for next sprint. Who can own C2? @Samir
Samir: I'll own C2. If it's a rounding/config bug it's ~3d. If it touches billing backend schemas it could be longer — I'll escalate to payments now.
Maria: I'll take the top polish (response preview UX) — estimated 2d. I'll also draft the release-note blurb.
Anya: Rollout plan: canary on dedicated Thurs, then 50% next Tue if canary looks clean. If C2 requires a DB migration we need a fallback (toggle to previous calc). Add that to the runbook.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary 2026-03-25 08:00 UTC to slot canary-3 by Anya. Tag: release/v0.9.1-canary
Ben: Also recommend adding a small billing smoke test in Redwood Optimize that runs against canary tokens to detect any drift before we widen rollout. Low effort, high payoff.
Anya: Action items (confirming):
- Samir: C2 fix + payments check (due in 3d)
- TJ: add logs + KV traces for C1 (due in 24h)
- Maria: UX polish + release note draft (due in 2d)
- Ben: add billing smoke test to Optimize (due in 4d)
- Anya: prepare runbook + schedule canary (due today)

If no objections I'll mark these prioritized and update the sprint board.
Samir: No objections from me.
Maria: SGTM.
TJ: SG.
Ben: :thumbsup:
Anya: Updating the board now and will ping when runbook is up. Thanks everyone!
